# RecursiveTraversalOmitsDirectories

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="native" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 5.3" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs)

Include parent nodes when traversing directories. This opt-in inspection applies the policy stated in Detection.

## Example

Finding with the rule explicitly enabled:

```php{2}
<?php
$dir = new RecursiveDirectoryIterator("."); $it = new RecursiveIteratorIterator($dir);
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Include parent nodes when traversing directories.</li>
</ul>

## Detection

- Enabled policy requires directory nodes as well as leaves. Report construction of RecursiveIteratorIterator wrapping a proven RecursiveDirectoryIterator, directly or through RecursiveCallbackFilterIterator, when the mode is omitted. Highlight constructor call.
- Emit one finding per violating operation. Flow facts require a reachable path with no intervening mutation, escaped alias, unknown call involving the tracked value or analysis-budget exhaustion. Uncertain facts cannot prove a violation.

## Exceptions (no report)

- SELF_FIRST and CHILD_FIRST satisfy the policy. Unknown iterator source and arbitrary recursive iterators are excluded.
- An explicit mode, `LEAVES_ONLY` included, is not reported: the code states which nodes it wants (8 of 17 sampled findings on Symfony passed `LEAVES_ONLY` to list files only).
- Exclude shadowed builtin symbols, unresolved required types, incomplete syntax and unsupported PHP versions.

## Fix

No automatic fix. Choosing a repair requires runtime information, error-handling policy or a semantic decision.

All edits use exact byte ranges, preserve comments and evaluation order, and require syntax supported by the target PHP version. A fix must never add an evaluation or silently change unrelated arguments.

## PHP versions

Minimum PHP 5.3.

## Options

None. Enabling the rule declares the policy stated in Detection; the rule is disabled by default.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "RecursiveTraversalOmitsDirectories": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file):

```php
// @custos-ignore RecursiveTraversalOmitsDirectories
```
